option.name: --action-cache-path
tip: Defines the path where the actions get cached and host workspaces created.

option.name: --action-offline-mode
tip: If action contents exists, it will not be fetch and pull again.

option.name: --actor
tip: User that triggered the event.
Default: nektos/act.

option.name: --artifact-server-addr
tip: Defines the address to which the artifact server binds.

option.name: --artifact-server-path
tip: Defines the path where the artifact server stores uploads and retrieves downloads from. If not specified the artifact server will not start.

option.name: --artifact-server-port
tip: Defines the port where the artifact server listens.
Default: 34567.

option.name: --bind
tip: Bind working directory to container, rather than copy.

option.name: --bug-report
tip: Display system information for bug report.

option.name: --cache-server-addr
tip: Defines the address to which the cache server binds.

option.name: --cache-server-external-url
tip: Defines the external URL for if the cache server is behind a proxy. Be careful that there is no trailing slash.

option.name: --cache-server-path
tip: Defines the path where the cache server stores caches.

option.name: --cache-server-port
tip: Defines the port where the artifact server listens. 0 means a randomly available port.

option.name: --concurrent-jobs
tip: Maximum number of concurrent jobs to run. Default is the number of CPUs available.

option.name: --container-architecture
tip: Architecture which should be used to run containers, e.g. linux/amd64. If not specified, will use host default architecture.

option.name: --container-cap-add
tip: Kernel capabilities to add to the workflow containers.
Repeatable.

option.name: --container-cap-drop
tip: Kernel capabilities to remove from the workflow containers.
Repeatable.

option.name: --container-daemon-socket
tip: URI to Docker Engine socket (e.g. unix://~/.docker/run/docker.sock or - to disable bind mounting the socket).

option.name: --container-options
tip: Custom docker container options for the job container without an options property in the job definition.

option.name: --defaultbranch
tip: The name of the main branch.

option.name: --detect-event
tip: Use first event type from workflow as event that triggered the workflow.

option.name: --directory
tip: Working directory.
Default: .

option.name: --dryrun
tip: Disable container creation, validates only workflow correctness.

option.name: --env
tip: Env to make available to actions with optional value.
Repeatable.

option.name: --env-file
tip: Environment file to read and use as env in the containers.
Default: .env.

option.name: --eventpath
tip: Path to event JSON file.

option.name: --github-instance
tip: GitHub instance to use. Only use this when using GitHub Enterprise Server.
Default: github.com.

option.name: --graph
tip: Draw workflows.

option.name: --input
tip: Action input to make available to actions.
Repeatable.

option.name: --input-file
tip: Input file to read and use as action input.
Default: .input.

option.name: --insecure-secrets
tip: NOT RECOMMENDED! Doesn't hide secrets while printing logs.

option.name: --job
tip: Run a specific job ID.

option.name: --json
tip: Output logs in json format.

option.name: --list
tip: List workflows.

option.name: --list-options
tip: Print a json structure of compatible options.

option.name: --local-repository
tip: Replaces the specified repository and ref with a local folder.
Repeatable.

option.name: --log-prefix-job-id
tip: Output the job id within non-json logs instead of the entire name.

option.name: --man-page
tip: Print a generated manual page to stdout.

option.name: --matrix
tip: Specify which matrix configuration to include.
Repeatable.

option.name: --network
tip: Sets a docker network name.
Default: host.

option.name: --no-cache-server
tip: Disable cache server.

option.name: --no-recurse
tip: Flag to disable running workflows from subdirectories of specified path in '--workflows'/'-W' flag.

option.name: --no-skip-checkout
tip: Use actions/checkout instead of copying local files into container.

option.name: --platform
tip: Custom image to use per platform.
Repeatable.

option.name: --privileged
tip: Use privileged mode.

option.name: --pull
tip: Pull docker image(s) even if already present.
Default: true.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Disable logging of output from steps.

option.name: --rebuild
tip: Rebuild local action docker image(s) even if already present.
Default: true.

option.name: --remote-name
tip: Git remote name that will be used to retrieve url of git repo.
Default: origin.

option.name: --replace-ghe-action-token-with-github-com
tip: Personal access token for private actions on GitHub when using replace-ghe-action-with-github-com.

option.name: --replace-ghe-action-with-github-com
tip: Allow specified actions from GitHub (github.com) when using GitHub Enterprise Server.
Repeatable.

option.name: --reuse
tip: Don't remove container(s) on successfully completed workflow(s) to maintain state between runs.

option.name: --rm
tip: Automatically remove container(s)/volume(s) after a workflow(s) failure.

option.name: --secret
tip: Secret to make available to actions with optional value.
Repeatable.

option.name: --secret-file
tip: File with list of secrets to read from.
Default: .secrets.

option.name: --strict
tip: Use strict workflow schema.

option.name: --use-gitignore
tip: Controls whether paths specified in .gitignore should be copied into container.
Default: true.

option.name: --use-new-action-cache
tip: Enable using the new Action Cache for storing Actions locally.

option.name: --userns
tip: User namespace to use.

option.name: --validate
tip: Validate workflows.

option.name: --var
tip: Variable to make available to actions with optional value.
Repeatable.

option.name: --var-file
tip: File with list of vars to read from.
Default: .vars.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Verbose output.

option.name: --version
tip: Version for act.

option.name: --watch
tip: Watch the contents of the local repo and run when files change.

option.name: --workflows
tip: Path to workflow file(s).
Default: ./.github/workflows/.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Help for act.
